authoritativeReference.title: TABLESTYLE (DXF), Autodesk AutoCAD 2024 DXF Reference
authoritativeReference.field: Group 140 is the text-height field in the repeated TABLESTYLE row-style sequence.
authoritativeReference.implementationDomain: Only finite, nonnegative edited values are accepted, matching the existing typed TABLESTYLE writer; untouched raw source values remain governed by the established raw/typed preservation path.

changes: DXF-origin TABLESTYLE export overlays edits to existing group-140 text-height slots for the three documented row styles.
All other nested typed row fields must still match the retained raw projection; row slots are never inserted and malformed/raw-only records keep their prior replay/refusal behavior.
Edited ASCII group-140 lexemes are synchronized to a canonical finite numeric spelling while all unedited source spellings and raw group order are preserved.
Generated ASCII/Binary coverage verifies an edited height of 1.75 after readback and refuses a negative edited height without replacing an existing destination.
